subject: QMon signal mapping & rollout schedule for Brixton AI onboarding
messages:
From: Elaine Cho <elaine.cho@brixton.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@brixton.ai>
Date: 2028-06-14T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: QMon: request for signal mapping + evaluation cadence

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo earlier today — Brixton is excited to move forward. Before the implementation kickoff next week we want to confirm what you need from us to set up Quality Monitoring (QMon). Specifically: prompt sets, golden responses, and the evaluation cadence you recommend.

Attached is a compressed export of a few representative prompts we currently use (sample_prompts.csv) and a short doc describing our top-3 intent buckets. Can your team ingest these as-is, or do you need the prompts annotated/reformatted? Also, we have a short list of success metrics (precision at top-1, average hallucination rate) — are these compatible with your eval harness?

High level timeline from Brixton: procurement sign-off expected 6/20, target production canary 7/10. We want regression alerts folded into our PagerDuty channel.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call.

Best,
Elaine
Head of Product
Brixton AI

Attachments: sample_prompts.csv (text/csv, 18KB); intent_summary.pdf (application/pdf, 42KB)

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Cho <elaine.cho@brixton.ai>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@brixton.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-15T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QMon: request for signal mapping + evaluation cadence

Thanks Elaine — appreciate the prompt materials. Quick answers up front: yes, we can ingest CSV prompts as-is but we recommend a short normalization step (columns for prompt_id, prompt_text, expected_label, context_tags) to make the eval harness integration smoother. I've attached a mapping template in this thread.

Proposed next steps from Redwood: 1) signal mapping workshop (30m) to align intents -> prompt sets -> evaluation metrics, 2) drop-in of prompts into our eval harness (we'll run a baseline run and share initial metrics), 3) configure regression alerts and a canary policy for the first rollout.

Questions for Brixton: do you have preferred SLO thresholds for latency/prediction quality? Also confirm the PagerDuty integration key or preferred alert channel.

I've looped in Marissa (CS) and Rishi (implementation lead) — Marissa will coordinate the MA (mutual action) list, Rishi will own eval harness onboarding.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Sales — Redwood Inference

Attachments: qmon_signal_mapping.csv (template), kickoff-agenda.md (text/markdown, 3KB)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Cho <elaine.cho@brixton.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-16T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QMon: request for signal mapping + evaluation cadence

Elaine — welcome, and hi team. To keep the kickoff tightly scoped, here's a proposed 30m workshop agenda (attach: kickoff-agenda.md):

- 0-5m: Introductions and success criteria (Brixton)
- 5-15m: Signal mapping walkthrough (Redwood presents qmon_signal_mapping.csv)
- 15-22m: Eval harness expectations and baseline outputs (Rishi)
- 22-28m: Canary/rollback policy options and alert routing (Lauren)
- 28-30m: Action items and deadlines (Marissa)

Action-items I want recorded before the meeting:
- Brixton: populate qmon_signal_mapping.csv with expected_label column (deadline: 2028-06-18)
- Brixton: share PagerDuty routing or Slack channel for alerts (deadline: 2028-06-18)
- Redwood: prepare baseline eval harness config (deliverable: eval-harness-config.yaml)

One policy note: if the canary shows >5% regression on the defined prompt set for two consecutive days, our default is automatic rollback to the previous stable model and an incident ticket; we can relax that threshold if Brixton prefers. We'll review the detailed canary-policy.pdf in the workshop.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Attachments: kickoff-agenda.md (text/markdown, 2.4KB)

From: Elaine Cho <elaine.cho@brixton.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-17T08:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QMon: request for signal mapping + evaluation cadence

Thanks Marissa — we've updated the attached CSV with expected_label and added a small golden set (golden_responses.jsonl). We can confirm PagerDuty routing: brixton-qmon-oncall@pagerduty.com. Procurement is on track for 6/20.

On SLO thresholds: we can accept the default rollback threshold for the initial canary (>=5% regression over two days) but would like a notification-only mode for the first week after rollout so our engineers can triage before an automated rollback. Is that feasible?

Also, we have a question about the eval cadence — we plan to run weekly full evals and daily lightweight checks. Does Redwood support sub-daily lightweight evals (sampling + quick metrics) to feed regression alerts?

Elaine

Attachments: qmon_signal_mapping_filled.csv (text/csv, 12KB); golden_responses.jsonl (application/jsonl, 28KB)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Cho <elaine.cho@brixton.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QMon: request for signal mapping + evaluation cadence

Great — thanks for the filled CSV, Elaine. Quick implementation notes and confirmed schedule: 

- We support lightweight sampling checks down to 1/hour that calculate key indicators (top-1 accuracy proxy, hallucination heuristics). Those can trigger INFO/attention alerts; regression-alert thresholds for P1 rollback are checked against the full weekly eval.
- For the 7/10 canary target: proposed timeline
  - 6/18: signal mapping is final (Brixton) — DONE pending your upload
  - 6/20: procurement sign-off — Brixton
  - 6/22: Redwood runs baseline eval (initial metrics posted to Drive link)
  - 6/27: we deliver eval-harness-config.yaml and a preview dashboard
  - 7/03: internal dry-run of canary with synthetic traffic
  - 7/10: production canary (48h observe window)

- Canary behavior per request: first 48h operate in "notify-only" mode (no auto-rollback). If Brixton wants auto-rollback enabled afterward, we'll switch the policy on at 7/12 00:00 UTC. We will, however, surface automated suggested rollbacks in the console and create incident drafts for your on-call.

Action items assigned:
- Redwood (Rishi): push eval-harness-config.yaml to Drive and open preview dashboard (ETA 6/22)
- Brixton (Elaine): confirm PagerDuty key and whether you want the Slack channel mirrored (ETA 6/18)
- Marissa: I'll hand the implementation runbook to you for customer follow-up.

I'll schedule the 30m signal-mapping workshop for 6/19 10:00 PT; calendar invite to follow.

— Rishi
Implementation Lead — Redwood Inference

Attachments: eval-harness-config.yaml (application/x-yaml, 6KB); canary-policy.pdf (application/pdf, 24KB)
